The sum of coefficients is obtained by setting \(x=1\):
\[
(3-1)^n = 2^n = 128 = 2^7,
\]
so \(n=7\).

The general term exponent is
\[
7-k-\frac{2k}{3}.
\]
For the coefficient of \(\frac{1}{x^3}=x^{-3}\):
\[
7-k-\frac{2k}{3}=-3
\]
\[
10=\frac{5k}{3}
\]
\[
k=6.
\]
The coefficient is
\[
\binom{7}{6}3^1(-1)^6=7\cdot 3=21.
\]

\boxed{21}
